recipes.name: Vegan Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 4 pounds (1.8kg) sweet potatoes, (scrubbed but kept whole)
1 to 3 teaspoons pure maple syrup ((as desired))
2 1/2 teaspoons brown sugar or coconut sugar
instructions: Bake the sweet potatoes. Preheat the oven to 425°F/220°C. Lightly slash the sweet potatoes several times with a sharp knife to allow for even ventilation. Place the potatoes on a baking sheet (I line mine with parchment paper for easy cleanup). Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork tender.

While the sweet potatoes bake, prepare the Crumble Topping. In a medium bowl, mix together the oats, walnuts, pecans, almond meal, brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Then pour in the 2 TBSP + 1 tsp (33g) melted vegan butter and 1.5 TBSP (30g) maple syrup and fold in with a fork until crumbly and just slightly sticky. Set aside.

Brown the vegan butter. Set aside a medium bowl near the stove. Add a light-colored skillet to the stove and add the butter. Heat over medium and stir occasionally. Once the butter is melted and foamy, stir often and swirl the pan to ensure even browning and cooking, until it foams and then eventually browns and smells nutty, a total of 5 to 7 minutes (will depend on brand of butter).Immediately pour the butter into the bowl to stop cooking.
Once the baked sweet potatoes are cool enough to handle, slip off the peels and discard. Transfer the potatoes a large bowl.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F / 190°C. Lightly grease a 2-quart / 2 liter baking pan.

Make the mashed sweet potatoes. Use a potato masher, ricer, or handheld electric mixer to break up the sweet potatoes and mash them but not until completely smooth.Pour the browned butter over the mashed sweet potatoes, and use a silicone spatula or wooden spoon to fold it in. Add in the vanilla extract, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt. Fold until all ingredients are incorporated and potatoes are creamy and smooth. Taste, adding more salt to taste or the maple syrup for sweetness (keep in mind the topping will add sweetness.)
Assemble. Add the mashed sweet potatoes to the prepared baking dish and smooth out the surface. Sprinkle the Crumble Topping over the mashed sweet potatoes.

Bake at 375°F/190°C for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the sweet potato mixture just starts to pull away from the edges of the pan and the topping is nicely golden brown. NOTE: If the topping is browning quickly at 30 minutes but the sweet potato mixture isn't done, loosely cover the dish with foil and continue baking. Cool for 15 to 20 minutes to help set up, then slice.
